body.name: hat_V_Bs
body.def: For \(n_s\ge2\), \(\widehat V_{B,s}=(n_s-1)^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}(B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}-\overline B_s^{\mathrm{obs}})^2\), where \(\overline B_s^{\mathrm{obs}}=n_s^{-1}\sum_iB_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}\); otherwise it is assigned \(0\) and the interval uses its full-range convention.
